claims.text: Octreotide (somatostatin analog) for suspected variceal bleeding: IV bolus, then continuous infusion.
claims.quote: Octreotide, a synthetic analog of somatostatin, is used in patients with suspected variceal bleeding. Octreotide is given as an IV bolus followed by a continuous infusion.

claims.text: Tranexamic acid doesn't seem to reduce mortality in lower GI bleeding but may have a role in variceal bleeding.
claims.quote: Tranexamic acid administration does not seem to reduce mortality, intervention rate, or blood product use in lower GI bleeding, but it may have a role in variceal bleeding
